michael_character: Composite dramatic figure drawing on Robert Michael Glover (the author’s father), Michael Emanuel Glover (the author), and scriptural archangel Michael as an image and exemplar; not interchangeable biographies or attributed quotations.
collaboration: Manny Glover with ChatGPT / Codex for the assembled edition and Six Authors exchange; Gemini for the author-supplied PDF collaboration; inherited pieces retain their original credits
coverage: Five previously published stage/dialogue pieces, the complete supplied Gemini PDF, the verbatim Six Authors exchange, four additional preserved dream/tea scenes, and the fictional One Quick Follow-Up sketch with fifteen framing scenes. The fictional WWIII movement follows the interview, with three further illustrations. Two Studies at the Crossing adds a further fictional chess-and-shelter movement based on two supplied PGNs. The author’s Atlanta porch recollection and a fourth illustration close the movement. Eighteen stage illustrations, the republic flag, and a standing board convention. Not a complete archive of prior conversations or the previous six to seven months.
